function.name: weather_get_by_city_date
function.description: Retrieves the historical weather data based on city and date. Unlike weather_get_by_coordinates_date, which retrieves historical weather from coordinates and a date, this retrieves historical weather from a city and a date.

city.description: The city for which to retrieve the weather.

date.description: The date for which to retrieve the historical weather data in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

function.name: weather_get_forecast_by_coordinates
function.description: Get the weather forecast for a specific geographical coordinates. Unlike weather_get_by_coordinates_date, which retrieves historical weather, this gets the weather forecast.

coordinates.description: The geographical coordinates for which to retrieve the weather. The first element of the tuple is the latitude and the second is the longitude.

days_ahead.description: Number of days to forecast from current date (optional, default is 7).

function.name: weather_get_by_coordinates_date
function.description: Retrieves the historical weather data based on coordinates and date. Unlike weather_get_by_city_date, which retrieves historical weather from a city and a date, this retrieves historical weather from coordinates and a date.

coordinates.description: The geographical coordinates for which to retrieve the weather. The first element of the tuple is the latitude and the second is the longitude.

date.description: The date for which to retrieve the historical weather data in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
